BREAKING: China’s PPI inflation rose +5.7% YoY in October, its largest YoY increase since June 2022.

This also marks its 3rd consecutive monthly acceleration.

By comparison, PPI stood at -3.6% in both June and July 2025.

The surge was driven by higher energy and non-ferrous metal prices, alongside growing demand for AI-related hardware, pushing factory costs higher.

Meanwhile, producer purchasing prices, which measure what factories pay for raw materials, energy and other production inputs, jumped +7.9% YoY, the largest increase since June 2022.

Inflation is back in China.

It's official!

BREAKING: The total circulating supply of onchain tokenized equities surged by +$932 million last week, the biggest weekly jump on record.

This puts total supply above $4.7 billion, also a fresh record high.

Amid the US Midterm elections and the resulting volatility, tokenized equities saw historic volume.

In times of volatility, investors are increasingly favoring tokenized securities which trade 24/7.

The largest onchain trading platform on Solana, Jupiter, reported +60% MoM growth in the number of tokenized equity traders, with volume up +34%.

Furthermore, 62% of that volume now reportedly takes place outside of market hours.

Volatility is accelerating the adoption of tokenization.

To those who are obsessed with tracking posts so they can point out when someone is wrong, let me save you some time: I’m wrong often. In fact, I’m wrong more often than I’m right on most of my trades.
At times I’ll run a better than 50/50 batting average, but over the long run, if you judged my trading simply by how often I was right versus wrong, you probably wouldn’t be very impressed.
So when you point out a stock or market call that I or someone else missed, the only person who thinks it’s eventful is you.
Being wrong is a normal part of trading. I know, I built a generational fortune being wrong more than being right.
So maybe you’re asking the wrong question.
